limitations: Only uniform perfect matchings and totals of two-edge crossing/nesting pairs. No finite independence of counts, no convergence rate, no assertion about maximal crossing/nesting size. A March 2000 supporting report lacks a verified exact public release day.
scientific_integrity: The simultaneous Gaussian theorem is proved by a bounded second-order U-statistic projection. Classical univariate crossing moments and the preexisting full joint enumerator are acknowledged, not asserted novel. No independent proof or historical-priority audit has occurred.
title: Orthogonal crossing–nesting fluctuations in uniform random matchings
